lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: ... Good. It's done.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Please work.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: One, two, three!

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: *Gasp*!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Ahh!

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Phew... it worked. You survived.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Abe... what happened?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Cinderella, she...

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It wasn't a dream, was it?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No. That was no dream.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I are alive?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: More or less. You were half dead.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: What happened? Where is this place?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: First, let's finish your repairs.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Red Shoes, some help?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: O-okay.
Soon after.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Our arms hurt.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You'll have to deal with it. It's a miracle that I even have you up and running.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Besides, you're better off than Siren. She lost her jaw.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: And Red Shoes lost her leg.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel says it hurts a lot.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I know. We're all hurting badly.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: But we're all gritting our teeth and pushing through the pain.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Gretel will have to do the same.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We don't like pain.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Who the hell does?! Stop whining.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We're in pain.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I know that! Stop...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: It's not our body that hurts.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We believe it's our heart that's in pain.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Cinderella.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Did she betray us?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Siren... Don't talk.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What if your Kotodama activates?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: My Kotodama did nothing.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: *Cough, cough*!

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: There was nothing wrong with the spell.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Your jaw was pounded into a pulp.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I managed to re-attach it, but barely, so don't talk too much.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: If something were to go wrong, your life would be in danger.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Ahooh.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: As for Cinderella... she's been corrupted.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Everyone is calling her Anachiro now.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I don't know where she could have possibly contracted it,

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: but that's the conclusion everyone has reached.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Right now, she's...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: She's considered an enemy of the people.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: In a sense, she's doing quite well, but not exactly in the way we intended...

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: At least everyone is sa... alive.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I thought we were done for.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Don't even bring that up.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I went through hell.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: After we got pummeled by Cinderella, the Raptures invaded the research lab.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Did you all hear it when she used the calling signal?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Yes, I heard it. It's meant to attract Raptures to whatever location it's emitted from.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I can't believe she was able to do that...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: The Raptures came in and smashed everything to pieces.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It's a miracle I was intact enough to move you all to the internal shelter.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... Thank you. I know it wasn't easy for you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Well, one upside of you all having a few parts ripped off was that it made you lighter.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: A joke! Just a joke.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Anyway, after dragging you all in here, I put you in emergency repair enclosures.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I was going to repair you, but I didn't have any spare parts to work with,

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: so I had to go back outside and into the lab to find your spare bodies.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... That was reckless of you, Abe.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What else could I have done? Left you all to die?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: When I got there, it was quite a sight to behold.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Mass-produced Nikkes guarding the facility were getting cut down in giant swathes by the Raptures.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It's terrible to say, but that distracted the Raptures enough so that I was able to move around the lab unimpeded.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Before long, I was able to get to where your spare bodies were stored.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: In other words, you used them as a shield?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: In a way, yes.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: You should have helped!

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I can't fight.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: And you all are more valuable than any amount of mass-produced units.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Abe!

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: If I had joined the fight, we all would have been toast.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: If it weren't for me, you all would have been left to die.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Instead of rebuking me for not taking part in a suicide mission, you should be thanking me for saving your lives.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: If you're not going to thank me, then just keep your mouth shut.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... I'm sorry. Thank you, Abe.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Jeez, I practically had to force it out of you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Anyway, after securing the parts, I somehow made it back to the secret base connected to the shelter.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: For the next two months, I slaved away struggling to fix you guys.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... Two whole months?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: How much have things changed in the meantime?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Nothing too drastic. We're still getting our butts handed to us by the Raptures.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: But why did you do it alone, Abe?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: You said it took two months to repair us? It's strange that you didn't have any support.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It sounds arrogant to say this, but we are second generation Grimms models.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: It's rather odd that no one offered to help you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: The communication device is broken.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I was going to fix it after I was finished with you.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... It shouldn't take long to fix something like that.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You don't know how badly it's broken. It's way above my skill level.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I need to relax. I haven't had any rest for the past two months.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I know that's the entire reason I became a Nikke, but I never thought I'd see the day when I actually couldn't get any sleep.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ahh. Aooh.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We're grateful to you, Abe.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We'll let you get some rest.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: ... Thanks. I'm touched.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You all stand guard. If anything funny happens, wake me up immediately. Okay?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Aooh.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Okay.
That evening.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: *Snooooore*

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... Gretel and I think Abe's snoring is Goddess level.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We can hear it all the way from over here.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ahh. Aooh.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: What's happening to Cinderella?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ahh.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We know.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Any Nikkes who are corrupted are disposed of. No exceptions.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She's sided with the Raptures.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She's no longer our comrade.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Aooh...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ahhooh!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We don't understand what you mean.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooohahh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: She could come back.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: *Cough!* Ugh!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You shouldn't speak.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Red Shoes. Has anything like that ever happened before?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: No. Not even once.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: We looked back through the records at V.T.C., but there wasn't a single case.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: There are cases where they were able to resist for longer periods, but...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Aooh...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: what should we do

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: when we see Cinderella next?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Will we be able to reason with her?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: No. It will be impossible to speak with her.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: What then?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: We will... probably end up having to fight.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ahhoohah!!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ahh! Ahhooh!

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I'll look around the facility for a bit.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I think you're just trying to avoid an awkward situation.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... You're not wrong.
Control room.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I can't calm down.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Gotta get a grip...

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The communication cables...

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: They've been cut.
